parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description:
The event name.

>For more information, call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The source identifier of the request. Set the value to sas.

parameters.name: IncidentTime
parameters.description: The time when the event was first detected.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The vertex type. You can call the [DescribeTraceInfoDetail](~~DescribeTraceInfoDetail~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server to query. You can call the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
